title: is_flash_key call-sites list will drift as new key-free paths are added
description: wp11_key_obj_t in wp11_pkcs11.c carries a comment listing every code path that checks is_flash_key before calling wp11_soft_key_free. Currently: C_Finalize and C_DestroyObject. Any contributor adding a third key-free path who misses this comment gets a double-free or use-after-free on flash key_priv, which points into keystore memory that wp11_keystore_free will also free. This is resolved cleanly by the ops-table refactor (wolfP11-be5): storing const wp11_backend_ops_t * on the key object makes the ownership explicit in structure rather than in a comment. Depends on wolfP11-be5.
